_readme: THE STORE LISTING LANGUAGE TABLE: which code each store spells a register locale with. [lane aso-listings, O-STORE-LISTINGS-ENGLISH-ONLY]
A language has ONE name in this repository: its code in tooling/i18n/locales.json (`en`, `hi`, `ta`). The listing tree uses that
name (the flat store/<channel>/ folder is the register's sourceLocale; every other locale is store/<channel>/<code>/), and so do
store/listing-locales.json, the review sheets and assert-bundle-locales limb B. A STORE spells the same language its own way
(Play `hi-IN`, Microsoft `hi-in`), so the mapping happens at the edge, here, and only the submit tools read it
One block per app-surface store channel in tooling/channel-register.json. Per register locale, exactly one of:
codes.<code>  the store's code for it, read from `source.url` on `source.readAt`;
skip.<code>   why this channel has no listing in that language (a store that localises nothing, or does not offer it).
tooling/ci/assert-store-listings.mjs limb L fails a register locale (supported OR pending) with neither, a code with no source,
and a channel the register declares that has no block here. Adding a language to the register therefore reds this file first.

source.quote: Hindi – hi-IN · Tamil – ta-IN (the page's 'View list of available languages')

The page lists English (U.S.), Hindi and Tamil among the App Store localizations, by NAME only. The codes are App Store Connect's locale spellings for those names; the page itself prints none, so the first --sync of a non-English locale reads the code back from App Store Connect before it writes.
The same App Store localization list serves the Mac App Store (one App Store Connect record per platform version, the same languages).
English: en, … en-us … · Hindi: hi, hi-in · Tamil: ta, ta-in

The snap's store metadata is ONE `summary` and ONE `description`, generated into snapcraft.yaml from the flat listing. No per-language variant exists in what this pipeline submits; the Snap Store's own limits and languages are UNVERIFIED (linux-snap/README.md 'Field limits').

skip.hi: The Snap Store listing carries one summary and one description; this pipeline has no per-language field to send a Hindi listing to (see source).
skip.ta: The Snap Store listing carries one summary and one description; this pipeline has no per-language field to send a Tamil listing to (see source).
